notes.docker_stats: Docker-reported container working set, sampled at the configured interval.
notes.cgroup_memory_current: Container cgroup total, including anon and file cache.
notes.torrentng_process_rss: Host /proc RSS for torrentngd when available; zero means unavailable.
notes.process_memory_snapshots: TorrentNG /proc status, thread names, smaps totals, and the 20 largest resident mappings captured with cgroup samples.
notes.engine_metrics: TorrentNG resource-governor leases, estimated peer-buffer capacities, storage-pool gauges, and optional allocator metrics sampled during transfer and at phase boundaries.
notes.jemalloc_metrics: Jemalloc allocator gauges are present only when the jemalloc-allocator feature is selected. They describe Jemalloc's allocator state, not total process allocations or RSS.
notes.source_fingerprint: SHA-256 derived from commit/tree, a normalized full-index Git diff, and all non-ignored untracked file paths and contents at benchmark start.
notes.process_memory: Linux /proc RSS, anonymous RSS, file RSS, thread count, and smaps samples are process-level readings; allocator gauges do not replace them.
